thread:
maria-sales: POC kickoff w/ MediStream tomorrow 10am PT. Procurement just pinged — they want clarity on signer flow + DPA redlines before we spin up the Dedicated trial. Can legal + security give quick thumbs on the order?

ajay-ps: Quick context — customer is multi-entity. Billing should come from Redwood US LLC, contract signed by MediStream UK plc. That entity split is the main blocker for procurement.

kyle-procurement: FYI they insist on a PO number matching invoice. Prefer PO before e-sign, but happy to accept PO after if legal says allowed. Net terms requested: Net45. :thinking_face:

liam-legal: Generally we don't accept a PO as a substitute for countersignature. Preferred sequence: MSA (signed) -> Order Form -> PO/invoice. DPA redlines attached below (very small). I'll prep a redline and push to DocuSign if folks OK.

liam-legal: ```diff
--- DPA (counterparty)
+++ DPA (redline)
@@
- 5.3 Subprocessors: Subprocessor list subject to Customer approval
+ 5.3 Subprocessors: Customer will be provided notice and opt-out rights for new subprocessors
```

sophie-security: Security quick check: SOC2 Type II current, pen-test from Q4 '25. They asked about data residency + encryption at rest KMS. We can provide SOC2 PDF and `sq_answers_medi.csv`. Also note: if they want Dedicated in EU region for residency, ops needs 3 business days to provision.

maria-sales: @sophie-security please paste the SOC2 link and the short answers here so I can forward. @liam-legal once redline is ready we'll need the exact signer names for DocuSign.

ajay-ps: Pricing note: Dedicated trial for a 2-week POC — ballpark +30% to hosted list, but we can offer trial credits of $5k and waive commit. SLA for POC: 99.9% best-effort, will not trigger formal credits for trial period.

kyle-procurement: DocuSign is preferred by customer if it's using KMS/HSM-based signing. Paper sign only if absolutely required by their legal. Signer matrix they requested: Exec (AO) -> Finance (AP) -> Legal (LG). Backup signer: FinanceMgr.

maria-sales: Copy that. I'm drafting a one-pager checklist for MediStream. Items to confirm: billing entity, PO timing, net45, Dedicated pricing uplift, and DPA redline acceptance.

sophie-security: SOC2 link: https://redwood-infer-soc2.example/report.pdf
Attachments: `sq_answers_medi.csv` (small CSV with QIDs & yes/no plus comments).
Key notes from SQ: Q12 (data residency) -> can provide EU Dedicated region or contractual obligation for redacted logs; Q31 (pen test) -> schedule window 3-4 weeks out.

docsign-bot: DocuSign envelope created 1798642650 for MSA + DPA + Order Form. Status: waiting for recipient signatures. Envelope ID: env_1798642650.

liam-legal: I'll be primary signer for Redwood. Suggested clause to add to Order Form: "Counterparty acknowledges that DPA obligations bind upon execution of the MSA by both parties." Minimal wording to avoid extra negotiation.

kyle-procurement: If customer insists on PO prior to signature, ask them to issue a "pre-PO reference" that notes it's subject to fully executed contract. That usually gets Finance comfortable.

maria-sales: Action items: 1) @liam-legal upload redline to DocuSign (in progress). 2) @sophie-security drop SOC2 + `sq_answers_medi.csv` here (done). 3) @ajay-ps send short pricing note for Dedicated trial (ETA 2h). 4) @kyle-procurement confirm if pre-PO reference acceptable to AM or if they need a signed PO first. I'll update MediStream after those 4 are complete. :thumbsup:

ajay-ps: Pricing note: sending a short table to this thread in 15m with trial uplift + credits.

kyle-procurement: Pre-PO reference is acceptable to AM as long as it says "Subject to contract" and includes PO number. We can accept that to expedite provisioning.

maria-sales: Perfect — that's actionable. I'll loop in AM and paste the checklist into the customer email. Thanks everyone.

liam-legal: Uploaded redline and sent envelope 1798642650. Tagging here so people can watch.

maria-sales: Following up: MediStream replied, they will issue a pre-PO ref and accept DocuSign with KMS. Moving to sign tomorrow morning.

kyle-procurement: Will prepare invoice template with PO ref mapping. Once fully executed, we'll send final invoice.

maria-sales: Closing thread after sign-off. Thanks all.
